tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate the price to ship a car with Cross Country Movers between two US locations. Use when the user asks what it costs to ship or transport a vehicle. Returns route, driving miles, open and enclosed prices (or 'call for quote'), a recommendation, a 3-day pickup window, transit days and a booking

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Send the user's name and phone or email to Cross Country Movers so an agent can follow up on a quote from get_quote. Only call after the user explicitly asks to be contacted and agrees (consent=true). Sends one email to the Cross Country Movers team; calling again sends again.
